_comment: World prompts, messages and seal hints (English). Hint keys: c1.322 = chapter 1, page 322; c1.601:104 = the part of surah 104 on page 601.
world.respawn: The dream gently takes you back.
market.key_found: At the bottom of a pocket: a small metal key.
parade.cortege: A procession… all the gold in the world seems to follow it.
parade.qarun_fell: The earth swallowed him, and his dwelling.
hint.c1.1: A faint glimmer near the bench… Stay still for a moment.
hint.c1.601:104: A sealed chest. The key must be somewhere among these fabrics…
hint.c1.295: Something glows in the shadows. Be patient.
hint.c1.304: A seal of light. The other pages of the cave must join it first.
hint.c1.604: The seal of dawn will only open once all the other pages have returned.
hint.c2.353: A table for two, a candle… Stay still for a moment.
hint.c2.85: A seal: the first saying must be read first.
hint.c2.123: A seal: the first two stages must be read first.
hint.c2.575: A mound, a bare slab… Stay still beside them.
hint.c2.582: The seal of dawn will only open once all the other pages have returned.
